en.headline: Police constable left vegetative after 2005 knife attack dies after 21 years
en.dek: Chu Chun-kwok, who was paralysed from the neck down after being slashed while on duty in Cheung Sha Wan, died at Kwong Wah Hospital on Wednesday aged 52.
body: A police constable who spent more than two decades in a vegetative state after a knife attack while on duty has died.

Chu Chun-kwok, 52, died at Kwong Wah Hospital in Yau Ma Tei on Wednesday, 21 years after he was critically injured. In July 2005, then aged about 30, Chu was on patrol in Cheung Sha Wan when he stopped a man for identity checks. The man, later identified as Liu Chi-yung, suddenly attacked him with a fruit knife, severing a carotid artery.

Despite the wound Chu chased the attacker about 50 metres before collapsing from blood loss and brain hypoxia. He never regained consciousness and remained paralysed. Liu surrendered the same day and was later sentenced to 10 years in prison after an appeal.
Chu’s family cared for him throughout the years. Relatives and colleagues had been informed in recent days that his condition was critical.

zh.headline: 2005年執勤遇刺成植物人警員朱振國離世
zh.dek: 前警員朱振國2005年在深水埗執勤時遭刀割頸動脈，其後成為植物人21年，周三於廣華醫院離世，終年52歲。
body: 前警員朱振國周三於油麻地廣華醫院離世，終年52歲。他於2005年7月執勤時遇刺，其後一直處於植物人狀態，長達21年。
事發當日，朱振國在深水埗保安道市政大廈外截查一名男子身分證明文件時，遭對方以生果刀割頸，左邊頸動脈被刺中。他負傷追趕疑犯約50米後不支昏倒，因失血過多導致腦缺氧，此後再無甦醒。
疑犯廖智勇當日下午向警方自首，其後被判監10年。朱振國的家人多年來悉心照顧他，近日家屬獲告知其情況危殆。
